name: Critical Effects (BC): Energy - Head
description: Black Crusade, Table 7-9 (p. 249). Look up the total Critical Damage. Mechanical effects only - read the full description from the rulebook.

results.text: -10 to all tests except Toughness for 1 round.
Deafened until the target receives first aid or [[1d5]] hours pass.
2 levels of Fatigue and Blinded for [[1d5]] rounds.
Blinded for [[1d10]] rounds, Stunned for 1 round, 1 permanent Fellowship Damage.
Blinded for [[1d10]] hours. [[1d5]] permanent Fellowship Damage, 1 permanent Perception Damage and [[1d5]] levels of Fatigue.
Permanently Blinded and [[1d10]] levels of Fatigue. Roll [[1d10]] for the target's new Fellowship, unless it is already 10 or less.

The target dies. His burning body runs [[2d10]] metres in a random direction (use the scatter diagram). Anything flammable it passes, characters included, must pass a Challenging (+0) Agility Test or catch fire.
